7 انخرع It became cut, or divided, lengthwise; it became slit, or split; it slit, or split. (S.) And انخرعت القَنَاةُ The spear-shaft split, and broke into pieces, or into small pieces. (K.) ―
-b2- I. q. انخلع; (K;) a dial. var. of the latter; as in the phrase انخرعت كَتِفُهُ [His shoulder-blade became dislocated]. (S.) You say also, انخرعت أَعْضَآءُ البَعِيرِ The limbs of the camel became displaced; as also ↓ تخرّعت . (TA.) ―
-b3- See also two significations above, voce خَرِعَ, in two places. ―
-b4- [Whence,] اِنْخَرَعْتُ لَهُ (assumed tropical:) I became gentle, or mild, to him. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
